create.name: Vedanta Ashram, Indore (Vedanta Mission)
create.bio:
Vedanta Ashram is a small gurukula for the study of Advaita Vedanta in the Sudama Nagar area of Indore, Madhya Pradesh. Swami Atmananda Saraswati, known to students as Poojya Guruji, set it up in 1992 as a place for himself and his disciples to live, study and practise, and it has grown into the headquarters of the International Vedanta Mission, run by a charitable public trust. Around six resident students live there, some of them initiated into sannyasa, with room for about twenty visitors during camps, a satsang and meditation hall, a library and a Shiva temple. Teaching is shared with the swaminis Amitananda, Poornananda and Samatananda.

The ashram runs a long-term Vedanta course and short residential camps, daily Gita classes with the classical commentary (bhashya), weekly online classes on the Gita and Atma-bodha, and correspondence-style online courses on Tattva Bodha and the Gita whose first lesson is free. It also publishes e-books and two e-magazines. Its YouTube channel, running since 2014, carries complete recorded series of Guruji's talks on the Upanishads and the Bhagavad Gita, mainly in Hindi with some in Gujarati.

courses.title: Tattva Bodha & Gita Intro online courses
courses.description: Two self-paced Vedanta courses by email: Tattva Bodha in four parts of ten lessons, and a ten-lesson introduction to the Bhagavad Gita. After the free first lesson, students send in answers and register with a small contribution to continue.

free_resources.title: Atma-bodha Lessons
free_resources.description: Recorded lessons on the Atma-bodha, a short introductory text of Advaita Vedanta, from the ashram's audio library.

free_resources.title: Meditation: introduction and guidance
free_resources.description: Audio talks by Swami Atmananda on meditation and japa practice, in Hindi, with archive links.

free_resources.title: Publications (ebooks)
free_resources.description: The mission's free e-books, including the Tattva Bodha text with English and Hindi translations.
